_comment: Recorded perf baselines (PERF §5). Each entry: the pinned number, the release that measured it, and what regression looks like. All tests here run in the normal suite — there is no perf marker or tolerance flag (that harness was never built; the ratio-test table in PERF §5 is aspirational).

conftest_snapshot.note: T-9: conftest._BASELINE_MODS snapshot size. Growth past the budget means the per-test _restore() cost is drifting up — trim module state or split a module before adding more. Re-measured at 0.89.2 (turn split into turn_footer/tool_prefetch/argsalvage/turn_retry; 81 -> 85, prompt registry adds _prompts.py -> 86). Budget raised 86 -> 95 with ledger justification: the 0.88.x/0.89.x monolith decomposition (memory, compress, subagent, dispatch, turn) trades one _restore() scan over 5 fat module dicts for 17 small ones — same total entries (3560 vs 3023 at 0.68.0), +18% over five minor releases, and it is the direction the repo's stated convention (nx/_feature.py per concern) requires. Re-measured at 0.103.22: _project_tools.py adds the isolated manifest scanner, schema validator, and lazy handler loader; the entry budget rises 3900 -> 4300 to retain headroom for that focused module. Budget raised 95 -> 96 at 0.105.0: nx/_surfaces.py (steering queue + /tabs dashboard) adds one module with small module-level state (deque, two str slots) — +1 module, +58 entries. Budget raised 96 -> 97 at 0.114.0: nx/_platform.py (Windows-port primitives: locking, kill-tree, pid liveness) adds one module with small module-level state — +1 module, +~40 entries. Re-measured at 0.126.0 (97 modules / 4200 entries): the memory-drift stamping layer was deliberately folded into _memory_store.py rather than added as nx/_memory_drift.py because the budget was saturated at 97; budget raised 97 -> 100 (and entries 4300 -> 4500) to restore three modules of headroom so the next focused split doesn't force a same-commit ledger re-record. Budget raised 100 -> 102 at 0.135.0: nx/_render.py (UIUX_SPEC Phase B rendering vocabulary — panel/notice/kv_line/diff/stream_tail components plus the one box-glyph set) adds one module with table-only module-level state (two dicts, a glyph tuple) and carries no thread/timer/console of its own — +1 module, ~+30 entries. The second module of headroom restores the three-module cushion the 0.126.0 note intended. Re-measured at 0.137.0 (103 modules / 4555 entries): UIUX_SPEC Phase D adds nx/_fullscreen.py (alternate-screen shell, view dispatch, SIGWINCH notifier — no thread of its own) and nx/_review.py (/diff working-tree browser: read-only git probes + one view), and the /tabs and /sessions views live inside the modules that already own that data. +1 module and +1 module over the 0.135.0 re-record (the count also drifted with earlier releases' modules); budget raised 102 -> 105 (entries 4500 -> 4700) to keep two modules of headroom. Both new modules are table-and-class only at module level: no timer, no console, no thread. Budget raised (entries only) 4700 -> 4760 at 0.151.0: the /context and /memory fullscreen views add view classes and helpers inside data-owning modules (_ctxreport, _memory_cmd, _review-adjacent wiring); no new module, +150 entries of class/constant state, headroom kept for the /undo view. Re-measured at 0.156.0 (105 modules / 4773 entries): the batch task-override feature adds module-level state to _batch.py (model-spec validator, posture resolver, scope-install helpers) and to _approval.py/_approval_policy.py (task-level TLS slots + scope contextmanagers) - +2 modules and +65 entries of small function/constant state, no thread, timer, or console; entries budget 4760 -> 4863, modules 105 -> 107, keeping ~2% headroom. Entries budget raised 4863 -> 4980 at 0.158.21 (re-measured 105 modules / 4869 entries, NO new module): the 0.158.18-0.158.21 memory work added module-level constants and precompiled patterns to modules that already own that data only — _memindex segment-fold thresholds, _memory_store secret/supersession pattern tables, _memory_search RRF_K and snippet caps, _prefix satellite markers, _gitcommit diff-scan patterns. No thread, timer, or console added; module count unchanged at 105, so ~2% headroom is restored rather than a new upward trend. Entries budget raised 4980 -> 5100 at 0.161.0 (re-measured 107 modules / 4991 entries, NO new module): AUTOWAKE_SPEC Phase C adds four plain scalar wake-state slots to nx/_state.py (_WAKE_STALL_AT/_REVISION/_HOLD/_PENDING) — +15 entries of immutable-per-import scalars, no thread, timer, or console. HEAD itself measured 4976 of the old 4980 budget, i.e. the ledger had <1% headroom left, so this is a re-record at the same headroom ratio rather than a new trend. Re-measured at 0.164.0 (109 modules / 5119 entries): the PTC migration adds nx/_ptc_stubs.py (stub renderer: type-map tables, exclusion frozenset), nx/_ptc_exec.py (run_tools engine: schema, launcher source, refusal wording), nx/_ptc_rollout.py (rollout heuristic prefix tuples, status-line helpers) and small state blocks in _state/_breaker/_tool_gates/_dispatch — all tables/constants, no thread, timer, or console; modules budget 107 -> 111, entries 5100 -> 5320, ~2% headroom kept.
